shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json; cat src/App.tsx; cat src/main.tsx; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Switch ThemeProvider TextInput TextArea Modal Checkbox Progress Label Select; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; sed -n '1,140p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -Ls https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html; curl -Ls https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt; wc -c /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt; rg -o 'House|Squares4|Folder|FileText|Magnifier|Sun|Moon|Plus|ArrowRight|Bell|Gear|ChevronDown|ArrowUpRight|Ellipsis|Check|ArrowLeft|Xmark|CircleCheck|Clock|LayoutCells|Rocket' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | sort -u; rg -n '"'^#.*(Button|Switch|TextInput|Modal|Checkbox|Progress|Label|Select|TextArea|ThemeProvider)'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Switch ThemeProvider TextInput TextArea Modal Checkbox Progress Label Select; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json; sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -35; sed -n '1,85p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts; rg -n 'CSS|--gn-|--g-color|render|compact|menuItems' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader/README.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,195p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -165; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/Logo.md | head -90; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | head -105; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -55; rg -n -A 35 'interface ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; rg -n -- '--gn-|--g-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e 'const m=require(\"@gravity-ui/icons/metadata.json\");console.log(JSON.stringify(m).slice(0,1300))'; rg -n 'House|Squares4|Folder|FileText|Magnifier|Sun|Moon|Plus|ArrowRight|Bell|ChevronDown|ArrowUpRight|Ellipsis|CircleCheck|Clock|Rocket|Xmark|ArrowLeft|Gear|Bookmark|CircleQuestion' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; rg -n -A 55 'CSS API' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; sed -n '1,75p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/Logo.md; rg -n -A 18 'interface LogoProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts; rg -n -A 28 'interface ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 35 '"'^## CSS'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; node -e 'const m=require(\"@gravity-ui/icons/metadata.json\"); console.log(m.icons.filter(x=> /"'^(house|squares-4|folder|file-text|magnifier|sun|moon|plus|arrow-right|bell|chevron-down|arrow-up-right|ellipsis|circle-check|clock|rocket|xmark|arrow-left|circle-question|check|bars|persons|layers|sparkles)$/.test(x.name)).map(x=>x.componentName).join(", "))'"'; cat index.html; cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--g-progress[-a-z]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/*.css | sort -u; rg -o -- '--gn-aside-header-[a-z-]+width[a-z-]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | sort -u; rg -n 'width:|icon' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js | head -12; git status --short; cat vite.config.ts; rg -n 'font-family' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css | head -5"
